description: PROP-BILL-057 health check test (cross-cutting.test.ts lines 147-171) defines a local function buildHealthResponse() INSIDE the test body and tests that local function. This is a tautological test -- it does not test any actual billing-service implementation code. No health check endpoint (GET /health) exists in the source code (core/index.ts, shell/subscribe.ts, shell/cancel.ts, shell/types.ts, shell/errors.ts). REQ-BILL-032 requires a health check endpoint returning 200/503 based on DB status. This requirement is entirely unimplemented.
